steps.run: (() => { const list = document.querySelector('main ol'); const scroller = list.parentElement; scroller.scrollTop = scroller.scrollHeight; return { chatHasOverflow: scroller.scrollHeight > scroller.clientHeight, chatStartsAtEnd: Math.abs(scroller.scrollHeight - scroller.clientHeight - scroller.scrollTop) < 1 }; })()

(() => { const actions = [...document.querySelectorAll('main button[aria-label="Copy reply"]')].at(-1); const scroller = document.querySelector('main ol').parentElement; const jump = document.querySelector('main button[aria-label="Jump to the latest message"]'); return { lastReplyActionsStayInView: actions.getBoundingClientRect().bottom <= scroller.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + 1, noJumpAfterWidthChange: getComputedStyle(jump).visibility === 'hidden' }; })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('aside [role=tabpanel] button')].map(button => button.textContent.trim()); const compaction = rows.findIndex(row => row.startsWith('Pi compacted the chat')); const seventh = rows.findIndex(row => /^7You wrote/.test(row)); const sixth = rows.findIndex(row => /^6You wrote/.test(row)); return { compactionRowVisible: compaction !== -1 && rows[compaction].includes('requests 1 to 4 became a summary'), compactionFollowsTurnSix: seventh !== -1 && sixth !== -1 && seventh < compaction && compaction < sixth, effortChangeVisible: document.querySelector('aside [role=tabpanel]').innerText.includes('Thinking effort set to high') }; })()
({ compactionSummaryVisible: ['Compaction', 'Ship the plan in six steps.', 'Steps 1 to 4 are done.'].every(text => document.querySelector('aside [role=tabpanel]').innerText.includes(text)) })
